## Selected case studies

- [Adaptive checkout lifted conversion by 12%](https://example.com/case-studies/checkout-redesign/): Northwind. +12% checkout conversion, −30% payment drop-off.
- [An accessible design system for six product teams](https://example.com/case-studies/accessible-design-system/): Contoso. 120+ WCAG 2.2 AA components, −40% handoff time.
- [Learn-by-doing onboarding raised day-7 retention by 18%](https://example.com/case-studies/creator-onboarding/): Fabrikam. +18% day-7 retention.
- [Turning an ops dashboard into a decision tool](https://example.com/case-studies/operations-dashboard/): Contoso. −35% task time.

## Product approach

Design workflows, not just UI. Optimise the most-used tasks. Ship the smallest valuable thing. Reuse before you reinvent. An edge case is a use case.

## Skills

Product design, interaction design, prototyping, design systems, accessibility (WCAG 2.2), user research, experimentation.
